$comment: Single source of truth for the IPC payload shape shared between src-tauri/src/model.rs + collector.rs and src/types/usage.ts. Each entry lists the exact, sorted, top-level JSON key set for one type — one level deep only, not recursive, so a nested type's own keys live under its own entry, not its parent's. Both a Rust test (src-tauri/src/lib.rs, mod schema_drift) and a TypeScript test (src/types/usage.contract.test.ts) assert their runtime shape against this file, so a rename/add/remove on either side that isn't mirrored here — and on the other language's type — fails that language's test suite. This catches field-name drift; it does not catch a field changing type while keeping its name.
